rustfs_guest_cgroup.scope: new RustFS container guest cgroup; whole native benchmark window includes setup, oracle, background and writeback; not physical IOPS or TiKV

denominators.blocks_quic: logical API bytes/calls; QUIC UDP payload excludes network headers; nested counters are not additive physical I/O
denominators.commit_pool: driver commit await; pool checkout includes possible lazy connect/configure; not server execution or queue-only wait
denominators.counters: before_active to after_active process-local snapshots; includes boundary observers/background; idle liveness separate
denominators.cpu_rss: CPU includes observers/background; RSS endpoints and lifetime peaks, not per-cell or simultaneous fleet peaks
denominators.cumulative_requests: whole native run including untimed phases; distinct from cell acknowledgements
denominators.latency: all outcomes; bucket0 below1us, bucket n [2^(n-1),2^n)us, final bucket includes higher latency
denominators.sql: classified client submissions; returned rows cover successful known-count SELECTs, not affected rows; no row-count distribution
denominators.throughput: completed cycles / active workload seconds; acknowledgements include open/close
